title: Siege of Ulsan
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Ulsan", at revision 1370746161, opens: "The siege of Ulsan was an unsuccessful Ming-Joseon attempt to capture Ulsan from the Japanese. The siege lasted from 26 January to 19 February 1598." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q490935, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1597 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
